figurative_meaning_en: End of life, cessation of one's existence
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার জীবনের দফা শেষ হয়ে গেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: His life has come to its final chapter.
The accident marked the end of his days.
note: The idiom draws from the metaphorical idea of life as a series of chapters or phases in Bengali storytelling tradition.
